message.content:
1: “Then stretch it upon a row of flat stones (independent clause)  
2: and burn it on a windless night.” (independent clause)  
3: He called the people together (independent clause)  
4: and did as she said (independent clause)  
5: and when the blaze died down, (dependent clause - adverbial)  
6: there upon the stones, with every twist and fiber showing perfectly, (independent clause)  
7: lay a rope of ashes. (independent clause)
